description: From Pollution to Progress: Encouraging Milwaukee Students to Love Their Air is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Wisconsin Department of Health Services Asthma Program; Children's Health Alliance of Wisconsin. Everyone deserves to breathe clean, healthy air. That’s why agencies and community organizations in Milwaukee, Wisconsin joined forces to transform schools into springboards that encourage children to become active participants in safeguarding their own health. Coverage: Wisconsin (2024). The toolkit gives Wisconsin as the location, 2024 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
